item.title: General Catalyst Unveils AI Transformation Stack at Its VC-Owned Hospital System
item.summary: General Catalyst disclosed on August 19, 2026, that its acquired hospital system Summa Health has deployed an integrated AI transformation stack comprising nine portfolio companies — including Hippocratic AI, Aidoc, Commure, and orchestration partner Percepta — creating what may be the most comprehensive multi-agent deployment in a U.S. health system.
